category_evidence_requirements: Assign categories before prediction using raw context and, when raw alone does not establish intent or state, traceable explicit user confirmation.
Keep raw observations and retrospective user recollection separate. Do not insert unrecorded values, selections, cursor positions, or inferred histories into raw evidence.
Bind the question, answer, source artifact, affected events and remaining uncertainty in provenance. Traceability does not turn recollection into directly recorded telemetry.
Do not change locked targets, binary labels, categories or judgments after prediction. This evidence principle changes no category definitions, quotas, counts, thresholds or scoring logic.
Label support does not establish held-out status, complete history, prediction/access-log coverage, independent full-context approval or KTL acceptance.

current_locked_label_provenance.role: Provenance of the two labels already locked under the general evidence principle; not event-specific classifier exceptions or new category decisions.
current_locked_label_provenance.retained_uncertainty: Click value and selection are absent in raw. Whether earlier paste30 failed or was deleted and its exact course remain UNKNOWN.
